summary: Desktop screen-share setup now rolls back system-audio capture started by the same request when later video setup fails, without stopping another active capture.

checks.name: Rollback path review
checks.observation: Missing/stale source, desktop capturer creation failure, video source/track creation failure, and CS_FAILED all clean up the request-owned loopback track/capturer after loopback audio starts. The guard leaves pre-existing loopback capture alone when this request did not start it.

checks.name: GitVerse Windows Flutter CI
checks.observation: The Windows runner completed Flutter tests, analyzer, and Release build with the changed native C++ plugin.

checks.name: Injected Windows runtime failure and retry acceptance
checks.observation: CI compile does not exercise native failure injection, active-audio preservation, source disappearance or a subsequent retry on a running Windows client.

remaining: On Windows, test a stale/closed source after system-audio capture begins, each native creation failure, and CS_FAILED; confirm loopback resources are released, an unrelated active track is preserved, errors are surfaced, and a retry does not duplicate audio or tracks.
